resources.string: Enter a full .eth, .wei or .gwei name, like alice.eth.
That name isn\'t valid under the naming rules. Check the spelling.
This name is written in a form its registry keeps as typed, and Freedom won\'t change its spelling. Use the registry\'s own app for it.
Only names with one label before the ending, like alice.eth, can be registered or renewed here.
.wei and .gwei names are registered and renewed one year at a time; .eth names for 1 to 10 years.
Couldn\'t reach Ethereum. Check your connection and try again.
Freedom couldn\'t confirm this with more than one Ethereum server (%1$d answered), so it won\'t act on it. Try again in a moment, or add your own RPC in Settings → Chains → Ethereum.
An Ethereum server gave an answer Freedom couldn\'t read. Try again.
A name contract isn\'t the version Freedom checked. Nothing was sent. Use the registry\'s own app until Freedom supports the new version.
The registry\'s controller changed. Nothing was sent.
The registry doesn\'t accept this name or term.
That name isn\'t available any more.
This name can\'t be renewed in its current state.
The name, its owner or its expiry changed since this was prepared. Check it again.
The price changed while you were reviewing. Nothing was sent. Review it again.
This sends %1$s plus the network fee, and the account holds %2$s. Add ETH to it, then review again.
The contract would refuse this transaction now, so nothing was sent. Check the name again.
The saved registration doesn\'t match its commitment. Nothing was sent.
The saved registration secret can\'t be read on this phone any more. The commit can\'t be completed; dismiss it and start again.
Registering needs the phone\'s secure key storage, which isn\'t working. Renewals still work.
Couldn\'t delete the name registrations saved on this phone.
Couldn\'t save on this phone. Nothing was sent. Check the free space and try again.
That registration isn\'t on this phone any more.
This step isn\'t ready to send yet.
%1$s already has an open registration, paid from %2$s for %3$s. Finish or dismiss it below to start a different one.
%1$s already has an open renewal, paid from %2$s for %3$s. Finish or dismiss it below to start a different one.
%1$s already has this registration open, so nothing new was started. %2$s It carries on below.
%1$s already has this renewal open, so nothing new was started. %2$s It carries on below.
This is being sent right now. Wait for it to finish.
This saved registration doesn\'t match its name. Dismiss it and start again.
Another wallet transaction is still going out. Wait for it, then review this again.
The network fee was priced too long ago. Nothing was sent. Review it again.
You declined it. Nothing was sent.
The wallet may have sent this. Freedom won\'t send it again: it checks the chain for the result instead. Look in the wallet\'s history too.
The transaction went through, but Freedom couldn\'t see its result on chain yet. It won\'t send it again; Check again in a moment.
The commit isn\'t on the chain Freedom reads yet. Check again in a moment; don\'t send another commit.
The commit is too old to register with now. A new registration would need a new commit and its network fee.
The transaction failed on chain. Its network fee was spent; nothing else was paid.
That isn\'t a Swarm website reference Freedom can point a name at.
A record on this name is too large to edit here. Use the registry\'s own app.
This name isn\'t active, or its records are kept by a resolver Freedom doesn\'t write to. Freedom won\'t replace the resolver; use the registry\'s own app.
This account isn\'t allowed to change this name\'s records.
The record already holds that value. Nothing needs to be sent.
The name\'s owner, resolver or this record changed since it was prepared. Nothing was sent. Prepare it again.
The saved record doesn\'t match what it was prepared for. Dismiss it and start again.
Enter one exact Ethereum address, not the zero address.
A text record needs a key of up to 128 characters and a value of up to 2048, with no control characters.
%1$s already has an open operation for this account. Finish or dismiss it on the wallet\'s Names page first.
The registration failed on chain: its network fee was spent, but the name wasn\'t bought and its price wasn\'t paid. The commit is still valid, so you can review step 2 again.
Check a .eth, .wei or .gwei name, then register it to this wallet or renew it. Each step is a wallet transaction you review first.
.wei and .gwei names are one year per transaction.
Expired %1$s; it can still be renewed by anyone during its grace period.
Renewing for %2$s costs %1$s, plus network fees.
Set up the wallet first to register or renew a name.
Registering takes two transactions: a commit, then, about a minute later, the registration itself. The name isn\'t yours until step 2 is confirmed.
Waiting for the transaction to be confirmed…
Commit confirmed. Step 2 can be sent in about %1$s.
Commit confirmed. Step 2 can be sent in a moment.
Out of date: check the name again.
Send step 2 before %1$s, or the commit runs out.
For an account that isn\'t in this wallet any more
Its commit is already paid for. Without it, Freedom can\'t send step 2 and the name isn\'t registered.
Freedom stops checking whether it went through. Look in the wallet\'s history before trying again.
1 of 2: commit. It costs network fees but doesn\'t reserve or buy the name. Registering needs a second approval.
2 of 2: register and pay for the name.
%1$s, paid at step 2, plus network fees
Sends %1$s: the price plus %2$d%%, in case the price changes before the transaction is mined. The contract refunds the unused amount to this wallet in the same transaction.
Renewing extends this exact name. It doesn\'t transfer it to the paying wallet.
Not one of your wallet accounts. Payments sent to %1$s will go to this address.
Freedom couldn\'t read your wallet accounts to check. Check this address yourself.
This review no longer matches the transaction. Check the name again.
Commit sent. Freedom checks for it and tells you when step 2 can go.
Sent. Freedom checks for its confirmation.
This phone couldn\'t save that outcome. Freedom keeps following it while the app is open, but after a restart it may show as possibly sent. Check the free space.
